title: Viva & Presentation Coaching
tagline: Structuring defense slides, answering tough examiner questions, and delivering with calm confidence.
outcomes: Structure a concise, impactful 15-minute thesis defense presentation within a strict 12-slide budget.
Formulate structured answers to the 10 inevitable defense questions asked by internal and external examiners.
Respond calmly to unexpected or aggressive questions and handle 'I don't know' with academic poise.
Execute technical rehearsals and morning-of defense protocols to master public speaking anxiety.

modules.title: Module 1: Defense Structure & Slide Design
modules.description: Slide budgeting, pacing per slide, high-signal visual layouts, and content triage.

lessons.title: Slide Budgeting: What to Include and What to Cut
Defense Slide Budget & Speaking Pace Planner

modules.title: Module 2: Anticipating Examiner Questions
modules.description: The questions every examiner prepares: justification of methods, sample limits, and theoretical novelty.

lessons.title: The 10 Inevitable Viva Questions Every Examiner Asks
Defense Question Flashcards with Model Answer Frameworks
Defending Your Methodology and Sample Limitations

modules.title: Module 3: Communication Psychology & High-Pressure Delivery
modules.description: Managing nervousness, non-verbal cues, answering 'I don't know', and handling adversarial examiners.

lessons.title: How to Answer 'I Don't Know' Without Losing Ground
Managing Anxiety, Pacing, and Physical Non-Verbal Signals
Responding to Hostile or Critical Examiners

modules.title: Module 4: The Final Countdown & Defense Day
modules.description: 48-hour rehearsal regimen, tech checks for hybrid/campus rooms, and the morning readiness routine.

lessons.title: Technical Setup for On-Campus and Online Vivas
